name: Link
label: Link
description: A text link inside a sentence or on its own, routed through the app's link component.

props.name: variant
props.description: `inline` sits inside a sentence, underlined and in the sentence's colour; `standalone` stands on its own line or beside a control, in the tertiary action text colour and its own type face. Both are underlined.

props.name: size
props.description: The standalone link's type size: `default` the paragraph face, `compact` the small paragraph face. An inline link always takes the size of the text around it. Distinct from no native attribute of an anchor.

props.name: external
props.description: The link leaves the app: it opens in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`, carries an outward mark, and tells a screen reader it opens a new tab.

props.name: externalLabel
props.description: Read after an external link's text, hidden from the eye. Defaults to "(opens in a new tab)".

props.name: disabled
props.description: Hold the link inert: it renders as text with `aria-disabled`, at the library's disabled treatment, and goes nowhere.

props.name: iconLeft
props.description: A Material Symbol name or a node before the text. A directional glyph mirrors in a right-to-left context.

props.name: iconRight
props.description: A Material Symbol name or a node after the text. A directional glyph mirrors in a right-to-left context.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component the link renders with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so it
navigates through the app's router; a plain `<a>` when unset. This
component can render on the server, so it never reads a LinkProvider:
pass the prop even under one. An external link always renders a plain
`<a>`.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.
